title: Stop the Sampler! Classifier-Based Adaptive Stopping for Sampling Kernels
one_line_en: Puts MCMC inside continuous non-acyclic GFlowNet theory: a learned stopping classifier d_F(s) decides termination, detailed balance ties the optimal classifier to the target (Theorem 3.6), total flow is minimal iff the expected length hits a closed-form n_Q* (Corollary 3.7); trajectory lengths drop 1-2 orders of magnitude vs ULA (Table 1).
one_line_zh: 把 MCMC 装进连续非无环 GFlowNet：学一个停止分类器 d_F(s) 决定何时终止，detailed balance 把最优分类器钉在目标密度上（Theorem 3.6），总流最小当且仅当期望长度取到闭式 n_Q*（Corollary 3.7）；与 O07/O08 是同一恒等式的第三个出口。
